---
title: "Binding pockets"
description: "Predict and visualize protein binding pockets with P2Rank by default or fpocket as an optional advanced backend."
---

## Current design

Protein Workbench now contains a dedicated **Binding pocket prediction** card. The current default backend is **P2Rank**; **fpocket** remains available as an optional advanced backend.

Three structure sources are supported:

- **Current AlphaFold structure** from the resolved Workbench protein;
- **Built-in demo · 1HEL lysozyme**;
- **Upload PDB**.

## Built-in 1HEL demo

The demo uses **PDB 1HEL**, hen egg-white lysozyme, X-ray structure at **1.70 Å**. Click **USE BUILT-IN DEMO** to load the structure and launch the default P2Rank workflow.

The current implementation renders the 1HEL structure in the 3D panel before the synchronous P2Rank run begins, so the user receives immediate visual feedback while prediction is running.

You can also download the bundled demo PDB.

## P2Rank — recommended backend

P2Rank is cross-platform but is an external application. Download it from:

[P2Rank releases](https://github.com/rdk/p2rank/releases)

Unzip the release; a separate installer is not required. **Java 17 or later is required.**

### Configure P2Rank

Set **P2Rank folder or executable** to either:

- the extracted P2Rank directory containing `prank.bat`/`prank`; or
- the launcher itself.

ProtVis also attempts automatic detection. The status panel reports whether the path/folder and Java runtime are ready. Windows path handling accepts pasted/quoted directory paths and normalizes them before detection.

Choose a profile:

- **Default · experimental PDB structures**;
- **AlphaFold / predicted structures**.

When **Current AlphaFold structure** is selected as the source, ProtVis automatically runs the AlphaFold P2Rank profile. Threads are configurable (default 2).

## What P2Rank returns

ProtVis normalizes the P2Rank prediction CSV into a pocket table containing fields such as:

- pocket rank/name;
- score and probability;
- pocket center coordinates;
- SAS points / surface atoms;
- residue IDs and residue count;
- generated pocket-residue PDB file.

Selecting **Displayed pocket** updates the 3D view so predicted pocket residues can be inspected in structural context.

## Downloads

The panel provides:

- **Pocket table** CSV;
- selected **Pocket PDB**;
- **Full pocket results** ZIP;
- built-in 1HEL demo PDB.

The schema-v4 run stores the structure source, backend, backend label, P2Rank profile and binding-pocket table together with generated result files.

## fpocket — optional advanced backend

fpocket can be selected from **Prediction backend**. ProtVis supports:

- a native `fpocket` executable on `PATH` or supplied manually;
- Docker fallback using the image `fpocket/fpocket:latest`.

When Docker is used, the UI can check/pull the image and distinguishes a missing Docker CLI, a stopped Docker engine and an unavailable registry/image. On Windows, Docker Desktop is the practical fallback when a native fpocket executable is not available.

fpocket outputs are parsed into the same Workbench pocket table/3D-view concept, while its native descriptors (including druggability-related fields where available) are retained.

## Choosing a structure

Use the AlphaFold route when the resolved UniProt protein has a suitable predicted structure and no experimental PDB is preferred. Upload an experimental/curated PDB when exact chain/residue numbering or experimental conformation matters.

::: {.callout-warning}
Pocket prediction identifies geometrically/chemically plausible sites; it does not prove ligand binding, enzymatic activity or druggability. Compare predicted pockets with conserved residues, known domains/PTMs, experimental structures and biochemical evidence.
:::

## Troubleshooting

**P2Rank not found.** Point the field to the extracted P2Rank folder or `prank.bat`/`prank` launcher.

**Java warning.** Install/activate Java 17+ and restart the R session so `java` is visible on `PATH`.

**No AlphaFold PDB.** Use the 1HEL demo to validate the local P2Rank installation or upload a `.pdb` file.

**fpocket Docker fails.** Confirm Docker Desktop/daemon is running, then use **PULL / CHECK FPOCKET IMAGE** before prediction.
